excerpt: For silica microtoroidal resonators, projected critical photon and atom numbers were (n0, N0) ≃ (2×10−5, 10−6). Quality factors Q = 4×10^8 at λ = 1550 nm and Q ≃ 10^8 at λ = 850 nm had been realized, with prospects for Q ∼ 10^10, and coupling efficiency into and out of the resonator could approach 0.99–0.999 while remaining in strong coupling.
overview: The microtoroid data identify one candidate path beyond conventional Fabry-Perot cavities. The metrics matter because large-scale networks need many integrated nodes with high input-output efficiency; the numbers also remain partly projected, so they support feasibility rather than completed network operation.
title: Microtoroid Coupling Metrics
